edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

basis.en: Song dynasty poem; the author died in 1101.

note.en: In 1061 Su Shi, in his mid-twenties and setting out for his first post, wrote this in reply to a poem by his brother Ziyou about Mianchi, a town where the two had once stayed at a temple and written on its wall. The image of the goose’s tracks in snow, 雪泥鸿爪, became an idiom for the faint traces a life leaves. Su Shi’s own note to the last line recalls that on that earlier journey their horse died on the road and they rode on to Mianchi by donkey.
note.zh: 1061 年，二十多岁的苏轼赴第一个任所途中，写诗答弟弟子由忆渑池之作；兄弟二人当年曾在渑池一座寺里借宿，并在壁上题诗。“雪泥鸿爪”由此成了成语，形容人生留下的淡淡痕迹。苏轼自注最后一句：当年马死在路上，他们骑驴到了渑池。

pick.en: Su Shi, still young, compares a life to a wild goose stepping on snowy mud: it leaves a claw-print by chance and flies on without looking back. I keep it because it is the most honest image I know of what a record is. Traces are accidental and they fade, and the wall with the old poems has already crumbled, yet the poem still remembers a donkey braying on a long road. This library is a place for claw-prints.
pick.zh: 年轻的苏轼把人生比作飞鸿踏雪泥：偶然留下指爪，便飞走了，不计东西。我留着它，因为这是我所知道关于“记录”最诚实的意象。痕迹是偶然的，也会消退，题过诗的墙已经坏了，可这首诗还记得长路上那头蹇驴的叫声。这座图书馆，就是存放指爪的地方。

excerpt.orig: 人生到處知何似，應似飛鴻踏雪泥。
excerpt.en: What is a life, wherever it goes, most like? / A wild goose stepping on snowy mud.
excerpt.zh: 人生到处知何似，应似飞鸿踏雪泥。

gloss.en: A wild goose in flight, a migrant that comes and goes with the seasons.
那 is 哪: how would it care whether east or west.
The monk Fengxian, who had put the brothers up at the temple in Mianchi in 1056.
gloss.zh: 老僧：指奉闲和尚。1056 年苏轼兄弟进京应试途中曾借宿渑池僧舍。

gloss.en: A stupa built for a monk’s remains after his death.
gloss.zh: 新塔：僧人死后，弟子为他建塔安葬骨灰。

gloss.en: The poems the brothers wrote on the temple wall on that earlier visit.
gloss.zh: 旧题：兄弟二人当年在寺壁上的题诗。

marginalia.en: The lines chain together: 雪泥 ends one line and 泥上 begins the next, and 飛鴻 comes back reversed as 鴻飛. Each image leaves a print on the one after it.
marginalia.zh: 诗句彼此勾连：“雪泥”收住上句，“泥上”接起下句；“飞鸿”又倒过来成了“鸿飞”。每个意象都在下一个意象上留下印子。

marginalia.en: 東西 may be literal as well. Su Shi was travelling west to his first post at Fengxiang, and Ziyou had turned back east to the capital.
marginalia.zh: “东西”或许也是实指：苏轼正西去凤翔赴第一个任所，子由则东返京城。
